current.name: Administration authentication
current.validation_rule: Merge, CI, build and deployment are technical states, not user validation.

lot_4_closure.note: Existing Event duplication is satisfactory to the maintainer and requires no dedicated follow-up lot.

decisions: One administrator account for the initial version
Initial account created with a dedicated initialization command
Password stored only as a secure hash
Authenticated state uses a server-side session
Browser receives an HttpOnly Secure SameSite session cookie
No JavaScript-readable authentication JWT or HMAC secret
Unauthenticated administration access redirects to login
Logout immediately invalidates the server-side session
Absolute session lifetime is eight hours
Idle timeout is one hour and activity may renew idle expiry without extending beyond absolute lifetime
Five failed logins in fifteen minutes trigger a fifteen-minute temporary block
Login failures use a generic message and do not disclose account existence
Failures and lockouts are audited without password or secrets
No CAPTCHA, permanent lockout or IP-only blocking in this version
Existing HMAC authentication remains a separate technical/API mechanism

planned_after_authentication.name: Providers and API synchronization core
planned_after_authentication.governance: Discuss concepts and decisions with the maintainer before detailed roadmap updates or implementation.
